subject: [PATCH v5 3/3] mm/vmscan: reduce lru_lock contention via vmstat-derived scan-balance cost

2026-08-04.patch_summary: This patch reduces contention on the lru_lock by moving the calculation of scan-balance cost from the producer side to the reclaim side, where it is derived from vmstat counters. The new approach involves snapshotting running vmstat counters once per reclaim cycle and deriving the balance from event deltas since the last run. This change improves the cost model across reclaim gaps and reduces lock acquisition sites. A dedicated spinlock, cost_lock, serializes access to the cost update and halving loop against concurrent reclaimers in the same memcg+node.
